messages.subject: RJMCMC
parts:
Hi everyone,

In the code below, I would like to use RJMCMC


Code <- nimbleCode({
  for (i in 1:S){
    y[1:N,i] ~ dmnorm(mu_y[1:N, i], prec = tau_y0[1:N, 1:N, i])
     mu_y[1:N, i] <- b[i, 1] * x1[1:N] + b[i, 2] * x2[1:N] + b[i, 3] *
      x3[1:N] + b[i, 4] * x4[1:N] + b[i, 5] * x5[1:N]
    tau_y0[1:N, 1:N, i] <- diag(psi_y[i] * exp(-Dist[1:N, i]/lambda))
   
    for (j in 1:5) {
     
      b[i, j] ~ dnorm(0, tau)
     
     
    }
   
    b0[i] ~ dnorm(0, 1)
    psi_y[i] ~ dgamma(1, 1)
   
  }
 
  gamma1~ dbern(psi)
  gamma2~ dbern(psi)
  gamma3~ dbern(psi)
  gamma4~ dbern(psi)
  gamma5~ dbern(psi)
  psi ~ dbeta(1, 1)
  lambda ~ dunif(0, D)
  tau ~ dgamma(1, 1)


configureRJ(conf = RJexampleConf,
            targetNodes = ("b"),
            indicatorNodes = c('gamma1', 'gamma2',"gamma3","gamma4","gamma5"),
            control = list(mean = 0, scale = 2))
 
})

I got an error: 
Error in configureRJ(conf = RJexampleConf, targetNodes = c("b"), indicatorNodes = c("gamma1",  :
  Reversible jump target node "b[1, 1]" appears to have a non-constant hyper-parameter, which is not currently supported for reversible jump MCMC.

Do you have any recommendations for resolving this issue? Thank you.

messages.author: f116cbe5c604c988
messages.subject: Re: RJMCMC
parts: Yes, the error is saying that the RJ target nodes - each of the b[i,j] - cannot have a non-constant hyperparamter.  In this case, that means the non-constant parameter tau, in the prior:

So you would need a prior more similar to:

     b[i, j] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

Also, are you sure you want b[i,j] to be indexed by "i"?  Just looking at your code, I feel like only having b[j] for j=1..5 might be what you're after.

Good luck,
Daniel
